 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The separator divides two aligned binary masks. Their overlap is marked 2.
    sep_color = 6 if any(6 in row for row in grid) else 9
    sep_cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == sep_color]
    rows = {r for r, _ in sep_cells}
    cols = {c for _, c in sep_cells}
    if len(rows) == h:  # vertical separator
        c = next(iter(cols))
        left, right = [row[:c] for row in grid], [row[c+1:] for row in grid]
        n = min(len(left[0]), len(right[0]))
        return [[2 if left[r][j] != 0 and right[r][j] != 0 else 0 for j in range(n)] for r in range(h)]
    else:  # horizontal separator
        r = next(iter(rows))
        top, bottom = grid[:r], grid[r+1:]
        n = min(len(top), len(bottom))
        return [[2 if top[i][j] != 0 and bottom[i][j] != 0 else 0 for j in range(w)] for i in range(n)]
"
}
